description: This file defines the TenantService interface which provides methods for retrieving tenant configuration information, either by tenant ID, subject distinguished name, or via OpenTracing span. It includes method signatures and default implementations for some methods, and references external classes like TenantResult and JsonObject.

classes.name: TenantService
